$comment: V5 performance budgets (docs/VERIFICATION.md §7). 'frame'/'drawCalls' are the desktop-GPU targets; 'ci' is the looser bound used on Linux SwiftShader software rendering (relative-regression signal, NOT GPU-representative).

ci.note: Linux headless SwiftShader: absolute GPU FPS is NOT representative (VERIFICATION.md §2). We gate the GPU-independent signals — bundle budget, sim-step CPU throughput, render-loop liveness — and only REPORT software FPS. The 60fps/16.6ms target under 'frame' is for GPU runners.
